name: llm-async-demo
description: Async request/poll LLM demo: Spring Boot WebFlux + Spring AI backend accepts a job, runs the LLM call in the background, and serves the result via polling. Job store switches between ElastiCache Redis and DynamoDB per request.

env.name: SPRING_AI_OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI API key used by Spring AI to call the OpenAI API (injected from AWS Secrets Manager in the deployed task)

env.name: REDIS_HOST
env.description: Hostname of the Redis job store (ElastiCache endpoint in the deployed task)

env.name: REDIS_PORT
env.description: Port of the Redis job store

env.name: JOBS_TABLE_NAME
env.description: DynamoDB table name used for the DynamoDB job store

env.name: AWS_REGION
env.description: AWS region for the DynamoDB client (set automatically in the Fargate task)
